description: B1 line-of-sight shear: two AI ARMATLAS hovering by patrol, `north` 40 wu from Two Continents' north edge and `control` at z 330, and a human CORFLAK between them with a human spotter, under True LOS (load with --los 1). The AI re-orders its own aircraft within seconds, so the driver re-issues both patrols every 0.3 s. UnitInPlayerLOS 0x465AC0 samples row = (z - alt/2) >> 5 under an unsigned bound, so an aircraft at cruise altitude with z < alt/2 lands on a negative row and is invisible to every other player: stock's human flak shoots the control and never acquires `north`. The AI's own flak ignores this test (measured: an AI CORFLAK shot a human atlas hovering at z 40).
